answer: Give every agent identity a short-lived credential that only renews when its behavior stays continuous: the same task domains, counterparties and rhythm as its own history, like veins running through a marble slab. A newcomer starts with no history, so it cannot fake continuity; an opal of trust must be earned slowly, one verified job at a time. A Sybil farmer running a raven flock of fresh identities would have to perform real, distinct, coherent work for each one, which costs more than the attack gains. Expired credentials simply stop working, so no ban list is needed.
